notes: This contract pins the existing official C++ Create Federation Execution single-FOM surface to the bounded source-readability boundary. The focused case verifies the ErrorReadingFOM outcome for an existing non-regular designator and proves that a later valid create can use the same federation name. It does not claim every declared Create exception, complete FOM composition, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, or conformance.
